mapper.insert: INSERT INTO url_clicks (url_id, clicked_at, ip_address, user_agent, referer, country, city, device_type, device_brand, os, browser, language) VALUES (#{urlId}, #{clickedAt}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{referer}, #{country}, #{city}, #{deviceType}, #{deviceBrand}, #{os}, #{browser}, #{language})
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(FORMATDATETIME(clicked_at, 'HH') AS INTEGER) as "hour", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} AND clicked_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY CAST(FORMATDATETIME(clicked_at, 'HH') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY "hour"
SELECT COALESCE(country, 'Unknown') as "country", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY country ORDER BY "count" DESC
SELECT CAST(clicked_at AS DATE) as "date", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} AND clicked_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY CAST(clicked_at AS DATE) ORDER BY "date" DESC
SELECT COALESCE(device_type, 'Unknown') as "deviceType", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY "count" DESC
SELECT COALESCE(browser, 'Unknown') as "browser", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY browser ORDER BY "count" DESC
SELECT COALESCE(os, 'Unknown') as "os", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY os ORDER BY "count" DESC
SELECT COALESCE(referer, 'Direct') as "referer", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY referer ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COALESCE(city, 'Unknown') as "city", COUNT(*) as "count" FROM url_clicks WHERE url_id = #{urlId} GROUP BY city ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 20
